STEP 1 - Scene: A light salad/fruit plate: mixed green leaf lettuce, two strawberry halves, a few blueberries, and several slices of green apple. Photographed from above (near top-down), slightly angled.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White square plate, roughly 22 cm across the side (the edge runs about 22 cm). Treat as ~22 cm square plate, area ≈ 22 x 22 x ~0.8 (rounded corners) ≈ 390 cm². Food is concentrated on the left-center and top; the plate is partly covered.

STEP 3 - Items: mixed leafy greens (lettuce), strawberries (2 halves), blueberries (~6-7 berries, mostly at top edge), green apple (about 4 slices/pieces).

- Leafy greens: ~30% ≈ 117 cm²

Total covered ≈ 47% (plausible given the visible spread).

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 94 g and ≈ 31 kcal. This fits a small side salad/fruit portion with some pieces already eaten (a bite is missing from one apple slice and a few leaves are gone), and it is plausible for what is visible; no dressing or oil is evident.

Estimated total: about 95 g, about 30 kcal.
